outcome: Time from admission to active labor
cohort: 15,259 primiparous women with a single term pregnancy undergoing induction of labor
finding: Duration of active labor was shorter in underweight women and longer in women with BMI ≥40 kg/m2 compared to other BMI groups, while time from admission to active labor increased with BMI.
mod_finding: While women with BMI ≥40 kg/m2 who reached active labor had similar rates of spontaneous vaginal delivery as normal weight women, they experienced longer active labor and higher cesarean section rates.
